title: What If You Got Locked in a Freezer With Your Crush?
tags: what if you were locked in
description:
Eighteen degrees below zero. A steel door with no handle. Four hundred frozen turkeys, one tub of mint chocolate chip, and the girl who sits two rows ahead of you in chemistry. Gus has nine hours before his body stops shivering — and three years of things he never said.

Two questions for the comments:
1) Freezer, or elevator? Where would you rather be locked in with your crush? One word.
2) What's the thing you'd finally say at hour nine? I won't tell her. Probably.

It's eighteen below in that comment section and Lia reads every single one. Subscribe and give her a reason to stay.

Real facts in this episode: why every walk-in freezer has an inside release handle, how fast you lose heat when wet, the "umbles" of hypothermia, why a smaller space warms faster, and why ice cream never freezes solid.
